title: 第21章 大火皇族焚天血脉九十九象极限之力第22章 九品紫纹玄华丹
content_zh:
当年的他是皇太孙，如今的他可是掌控大炎皇朝的帝王。
哪怕只是一具战斗傀儡，也拥有帝王的威严。
林玄若是不问，可以假装不知，但既然问到了，那就不能含糊。
林玄笑了！
“武者实力为尊，别说区区一具战斗傀儡，就算见到你的本尊，也要靠实力说话。”
对方虽贵为帝子，但他却是鸿蒙帝经的传人。
拥有这种无上传承，身份岂是区区大炎皇朝的帝子可比？
“你很狂妄！如果是在本皇的皇庭上，你已经人头落地了！”叶天沉声说道，目光异常冰冷。
“既然你这么厉害，为何在这战天塔中屈居第三？”林玄反问。
“你……你懂什么？”叶天被他一句话问得无比尴尬。
若是本尊在此，恐怕脸都要红透了。
“原因你不说我也知道，你的实力肯定不如上面那二位，否则不可能在这里屈尊。”
林玄一番话，让叶天哑口无言。
“算你猜对了，当年本皇年轻，一时大意被他们占了点便宜，但在私下的切磋里，我们其实互有胜负！”
叶天极力辩解，展现出帝王的威严和倔强，言语之间却有些底气不足。
这也让林玄无比好奇，上面那两个到底是什么人物，竟然能压同时期的叶天一头？
“出手吧，让我看看你的实力有多强？”
林玄催促对方，言语间甚至透露出一种居高临下的味道。
这让叶天十分恼火！
“小子，就算上面那两个，当年也不敢对本皇如此无礼，本皇要好好教训你！”

轰！
叶天展现出玄气境巅峰的强大实力，九十五头紫象虚影随之浮现。
龙象阶梯，九五至尊！
帝王威严，谁能抵挡？
哗！
大厅中灵镜前，所有围观者惊呼如潮！
“叶皇，竟然是叶皇！”
“你们还愣着干什么，快拜呀！”
“我等拜见叶皇！”
呼啦啦！
灵镜前跪倒一大片，除了玄副阁主之外，就连观玄阁的侍卫们也都跪了下去。
虽然叶天只是一具年轻的战斗傀儡，根本听不到他们发出的声音，他们仍然不敢怠慢。
毕竟，这可是一手掌控整个大炎皇朝的帝王啊！
帝威浩荡，不容冒犯！
content_en:
He was the grandson of the emperor back then, but now he is the emperor who controls the Great Yan Dynasty.
Even if it is just a battle puppet, it still possesses the majesty of an emperor.
If Lin Xuan didn't ask, he could pretend not to know, but since he asked, he couldn't be vague.
Lin Xuan laughed!
"A warrior is respected by his strength. Let alone a mere battle puppet. Even if you see your true self, you must rely on your strength to speak for itself."
Although the other party is the son of the emperor, he is the successor of the Hongmeng Emperor Scripture.
With such a supreme inheritance, how could his status be comparable to that of the emperor's son of the Great Yan Dynasty?
"You are so arrogant! If it were in the emperor's court, you would have been killed!" Ye Tian said in a deep voice, his eyes extremely cold.
"Since you are so powerful, why are you ranked third in the Battle Tower?" Lin Xuan asked.
"You...what do you know?" Ye Tian was extremely embarrassed by his question.
If I were here, my face would probably turn red.
"I know the reason even if you don't tell me. Your strength is definitely not as good as the two above, otherwise you wouldn't be able to condescend here."
Lin Xuan's words left Ye Tian speechless.
"You guessed it right. When I was young, I was carelessly taken advantage of by them, but in private discussions, we actually won each other's defeats!"
Ye Tian tried his best to defend himself, showing the majesty and stubbornness of an emperor, but his words lacked confidence.
This also made Lin Xuan extremely curious. Who are the two figures above, who can actually beat Ye Tian at the same time?
"Take action, let me see how strong you are?"
Lin Xuan urged the other party, and there was even a condescending tone in his words.
This made Ye Tian very angry!
"Boy, even the two above didn't dare to be so rude to me back then. I want to teach you a lesson!"
Boom!
Ye Tian showed great strength at the peak of the Xuan Qi Realm, and the phantoms of ninety-five purple elephants appeared.
Dragon Elephant Ladder, Nine-Five Supreme!
Who can resist the majesty of the emperor?
Wow!
In front of the spiritual mirror in the hall, all the onlookers exclaimed!
"Ye Huang, it's actually Ye Huang!"
"What are you still doing? Come on!"
"I'll wait to see Emperor Ye!"
Hurrah!
A large number of people knelt down in front of the spiritual mirror. In addition to Deputy Pavilion Master Xuan, even the guards of Guanxuan Pavilion also knelt down.
Although Ye Tian was just a young battle puppet and couldn't hear the sounds they made, they still didn't dare to neglect him.
After all, this is the emperor who single-handedly controls the entire Great Yan Dynasty!
The emperor's majesty is so majestic that no one can be offended!
